basic_details.job_title: Delhi University Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 Field Investigator, Research Assistant Posts
basic_details.short_information: Applications are invited from Indian citizens for temporary positions in the Indian Council of Social Science Research (ICSSR) funded Major Research Project (2025-26) entitled “Life Skill Education in under the Framework of National Education Policy, 2020: A Study of School Adolescents in India” at the Department of Education, University of Delhi. Interested and eligible candidates may submit their applications by post to the designated address by 4 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Prepare your application along with your CV and copies of your Bachelor's and Master's degree mark sheets.
Ensure the application clearly indicates the subject line “Application for the Post of Research Assistant/Field Investigator – ICSSR Project.”
Send the application by post to the address given below: Dr. Ananthula Raghu, Assistant Professor, Department of Education (CIE), University of Delhi, Delhi–110007
Ensure your application is received on or before the last date of 4 November 2026. Email: [email protected].

content_sections.heading: About DU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The Department of Education, University of Delhi has issued Ref. No: 199 dated 13-10-2026 to recruit personnel for a temporary Indian Council of Social Science Research (ICSSR) funded Major Research Project (2025-26) entitled “Life Skill Education in under the Framework of National Education Policy, 2020: A Study of School Adolescents in India”. The positions are purely temporary in nature and co-terminus with the project. Candidates selected for these posts will be engaged initially for five months, and extend up to the project tenure based on the performance/availability of the research grant.

rows.essential_qualification_required: Postgraduate in any relevant Social Science disciplines with a minimum of 55% marks. Preference will be given to candidates with NET/M.Phil./Ph.D.
rows.desirable_qualification: Prior experience of data collection, analysis and research report writing

rows.essential_qualification_required: Graduate in any relevant Social Science disciplines with a minimum of 55% marks. Preference will be given to candidates with four year graduation programme.
rows.desirable_qualification: Prior experience of field visits, surveys, data collection, and analysis

content_sections.heading: DU Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: It will involve conducting workshops and surveys in selected states, data analysis and report writing. It will involve field visits to collect the data and surveys in selected states.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare your application along with your CV and copies of your Bachelor's and Master's degree mark sheets. Ensure the application clearly indicates the subject line “Application for the Post of Research Assistant/Field Investigator – ICSSR Project.” Send the application by post to the address given below: Dr. Ananthula Raghu, Assistant Professor, Department of Education (CIE), University of Delhi, Delhi–110007 Ensure your application is received on or before the last date of 4 November 2026. Email: [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be notified via email and invited for an interview. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many total vacancies are available under DU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 3 vacancies are available, comprising 1 Research Assistant post and 2 Field Investigator posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of applications is 4 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the essential qualification for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Postgraduate in any relevant Social Science disciplines with a minimum of 55% marks. Preference will be given to candidates with NET/M.Phil./Ph.D.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential qualification for the Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Graduate in any relevant Social Science disciplines with a minimum of 55% marks. Preference will be given to candidates with four year graduation programme.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly remuneration for the Research Assistant?
faq.answer: The monthly remuneration is Rs.37000 per month as per ICSSR guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly remuneration for the Field Investigator?
faq.answer: The monthly remuneration is Rs.20000 per month as per ICSSR guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. How should candidates apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Candidates may submit their applications, along with their CVs and copies of their Bachelor's and Master's degree mark sheets, by post to the address given below, ensuring the subject line reads “Application for the Post of Research Assistant/Field Investigator – ICSSR Project.”

faq.question: Q8. How will shortlisted candidates be notified for the interview?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be notified via email and invited for an interview.
